basic.name: Percipience, Silent Dawn
basic.description_template: Deals Wind DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Black Swan's ATK to one designated enemy.

skill.name: Decadence, False Twilight
skill.description_template: Deals Wind DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Black Swan's ATK to one designated enemy and adjacent targets. At the same time, there is a 100% base chance of reducing the DEF of the enemy target and the adjacent targets by {{scaling2}}%, lasting for 3 turn(s).

ultimate.name: Bliss of Otherworld's Embrace/Enhanced
ultimate.description_template: Inflicts "Epiphany" state on all enemies for 2 turn(s). Then deals Wind DMG to all enemies equal to {{scaling1}}% of Black Swan's ATK. While in the "Epiphany" state, enemy targets take {{scaling2}}% increased DMG. For every 1 stack of "Arcana inflicted," there is a 50% fixed chance to additionally increase the number of "Arcana" stacked this time by 1. And "Arcana" stacks won't be halved after dealing DMG at the start of the turn.

talent.name: Loom of Fate's Caprice
talent.description_template: Every time an enemy target receives 1 instance of DoT, there is a {{scaling1}}% base chance for it to be inflicted with 1 stack of "Arcana". While an enemy target is in the "Arcana" state, they are also considered to be simultaneously afflicted with Wind Shear, Bleed, Burn, and Shock. The target receives Wind DoT equal to {{scaling2}}% of Black Swan's ATK at the start of each turn, after which the number of stacks is halved. Each stack of "Arcana" increases this DMG multiplier by {{scaling3}}%. "Arcana" can stack 50 times, and can continue to stack beyond this limit, with the excess stacks removed after dealing DMG. DMG from "Arcana" ignores 20% of the target's DEF. Only when "Arcana" deals DMG at the start of the enemy target's turn, adjacent targets take 1 additional instance of Wind DoT equal to {{scaling4}}% of Black Swan's ATK.

technique.name: From From Façade to Vérité
technique.description: After this Technique is used, there is a 150% base chance for each enemy to be inflicted with 1 stack of Arcana at the start of the next battle. For each successful application of Arcana on a target, inflicts another stack of Arcana on the same target. This process repeats until Arcana fails to be inflicted on this target. For each successive application of Arcana on a target, its base chance of success is equal to 50% of the base chance of the previous successful infliction of Arcana on that target.

2.name: Viscera's Disquiet
2.description: When an enemy target gets attacked by Black Swan, there is a 65% base chance of inflicting 5 stack(s) of "Arcana" on them.

4.name: Goblet's Dredges
4.description: When an enemy targets enters combat, there is a 65% base chance for it to be inflicted with 1 stack of "Arcana," and a 100% base chance to be inflicted with the DEF reduction effect from the Skill, which lasts for 3 turn(s). After using Basic ATK or Ultimate, there is also a 100% base chance to inflict the DEF reduction effect from the Skill on the hit enemy targets, which lasts for 3 turn(s).

6.name: Candleflame's Portent
6.description: Increases the DMG dealt by all allies by an amount equal to 60% of Black Swan's Effect Hit Rate, up to a maximum DMG increase of 72%.

eidolons.name: Seven Pillars of Wisdom
eidolons.description: While Black Swan is active in battle, enemies afflicted with Wind Shear, Bleed, Burn, or Shock will have their corresponding Wind, Physical, Fire, or Lightning RES respectively reduced by 25%.

eidolons.name: Weep Not For Me, My Lamb
eidolons.description: When enemy targets enter combat, there is a 100% base chance to inflict 30 stack(s) of "Arcana" on them.

eidolons.name: As Above, So Below
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: In Tears We Gift
eidolons.description: While in the "Epiphany" state, enemy targets take 20% increased DMG. And at the start of every turn or when they get defeated, regenerates 8 Energy for Black Swan.

eidolons.name: Linnutee Flyway
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Pantheon Merciful, Masses Pitiful
eidolons.description: The upper limit of stackable "Arcana" increases by 30. When an enemy target gets attacked by Black Swan's teammates, Black Swan has a 65% base chance of inflicting 1 stack of "Arcana" on the target. For every 1 stack of "Arcana" Black Swan inflicts on an enemy target, additionally increases the number of "Arcana" stacked this time by 1.
